key.name: last-channel
key.description: Station id of the channel selected when the app was last closed. One of frisky, deep, chill or classics. An unrecognised value falls back to frisky.

key.name: volume
key.description: Volume on a perceptual scale from 0.0 to 1.0. Mapped cubically onto the pipeline's linear gain.

key.name: notify-mix-change
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a new mix starts on the channel being listened to. Mixes change roughly hourly; live radio carries no per-track information, so this cannot fire per track.

key.name: audio-device
key.description: Identifier of the audio sink to play to. Empty means the system default. An identifier that no longer matches a present device falls back to the default rather than failing to play.

key.name: quality
key.description: Stream bitrate to request. Anything above 'low' (96 kbps) requires a FRISKY subscription; without one the app falls back to 'low'.
